what_constrained: Weather needed an explicit freshness limit while the offline clock and courier remained useful.
what_worked: Deterministic weather fixtures and Emery screenshots for clear, rain, snow, movement, and stale states.
what_differently: Include freshness and time-advance cases in the initial visual pass.

what_constrained: Palette changes had to preserve scene and courier legibility across weather states.
what_worked: Bundled settings tests and Emery palette/font screenshots confirmed the scene at different appearances.
what_differently: Exercise real companion-app save and physical Time 2 installation next.

what_constrained: A short GIF had to communicate weather and palette variety without implying continuous on-watch animation.
what_worked: Three authentic emulator states made a compact GIF and distinct screenshots; independent review found no defects.
what_differently: Capture a longer native minute-by-minute courier sequence if motion becomes a listing priority.

what_constrained: Seven distinct scenes had to fit a 200x228 display while keeping time, courier, and weather legible.
what_worked: A shared weather and road layer, emulator scene captures, and a C rotation test verified the shuffled four-hour schedule.
what_differently: Capture travel-mode transitions on a physical Time 2 before releasing the update.

what_constrained: The first date plate overlapped the clear-weather sun.
what_worked: Shifted the sun when a date is shown, rebuilt, and verified the corrected native capture.
what_differently: Test each weather scene with the optional date on before public release.
